forbidden.name: no-relative-import-into-another-package
forbidden.comment: A workspace package reaches another package through its name and exports (@zgeoff/cloud-topology, @zgeoff/cloud-health-check/contract), never through a relative path into its folder.

forbidden.name: no-relative-import-from-the-root-package
forbidden.comment: The root package (scripts/, e2e/, test-support/) reaches a workspace package through its name, never through a relative path into its folder.

forbidden.name: infra-shared-imports-no-group
forbidden.comment: infra/shared/ holds what several groups read, so it imports no group.

forbidden.name: infra-inputs-imports-no-group
forbidden.comment: inputs is the lowest group: it reads the stack config and the env, and every other group takes its values from it.

forbidden.name: infra-group-imports-only-lower-layers
forbidden.comment: edge, tailnet, ingress and cluster import only inputs and shared; index.ts passes every value from one group to another.

forbidden.name: infra-observability-imports-only-lower-layers
forbidden.comment: observability imports inputs, shared, and ingress for the cloudflared names it scrapes and alerts on.

forbidden.name: infra-cross-group-import-through-the-entry-module
forbidden.comment: One group reaches another only through its entry module, <group>/index.ts.

forbidden.name: infra-root-imports-only-entry-modules
forbidden.comment: infra/index.ts, the composition root, imports each group through its entry module.

forbidden.name: infra-test-utils-only-in-tests
forbidden.comment: infra/test-utils/ serves the tests and the test preload; the Pulumi program never loads it.

forbidden.name: not-to-unresolvable
forbidden.comment: An import the cruiser cannot resolve would skip every rule above, so it fails the check.
